# Pseudofractal_Web

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A deterministic, self-similar network topology generated by iterative hierarchical attachment, exhibiting fractal scaling and community structure. Provides a mathematically tractable model for studying how modularity and community formation emerge in complex topologies relevant to neuromorphic routing and resource allocation.
